test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b438f01c662bba95b6c18be15736881f991141b9e6aeee9c4f055d741b5e11e9.png]
solution:
The logic followed in the given figure series is :

From Figure (1) to (2):

The shape rotates 90º in the anticlockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/454f8114e6adf2eab659c29abab2a577312f8bda30deb24bc83d572417739425.png] 

From Figure (2) to (3):

The shape rotates 90º in the anticlockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb59eb5028d5bc34e0b933821d6ddc8c2db0c5169cdcb163dbbd1eb863af723a.png] 

From Figure (3) to Answer Figure (4):

The shape rotates 90º in the anticlockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e4d1e6546a8c678b9494e6f93c5cea7bced416edcbaced166adab2317ca170a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
